title: Propulsion Assignment
description: Submit a link to the landing page of your Web application running on Netlify. The landing page should include the following: Your full name and section, links to each of the lab assignments, link to the Kanbas application, and links to all relevant source code repositories.

title: Combustion Analysis
description: Analyze the combustion process of a rocket engine and submit your findings as a report.

title: Nozzle Design Project
description: Design a rocket nozzle and submit your design files and analysis report.

title: Aerodynamics Quiz
description: Complete the aerodynamics quiz covering lift, drag, and flow principles.

title: Flow Analysis
description: Perform a detailed flow analysis using the provided simulation tools and submit your results.

title: Heating Analysis
description: Analyze the thermal heating effects on a re-entry vehicle and submit your report.

title: Structural Design Task
description: Design a structural component for a spacecraft and submit your CAD files and analysis.

title: Orbital Calculations
description: Complete a set of orbital mechanics calculations and submit your work showing all steps.

title: Systems Engineering Exam
description: Complete the systems engineering exam covering all topics from the course.
